info.name: GreenLove Farms
info.description:
Auth, catalog, carts, promotions, checkout and orders stacks.

Run Auth → Login first; it stores idToken, which signed-in requests send as a Bearer token. Catalog → Admin uses adminIdToken from Auth → Admin login.

Automated run: postman/run-tests.sh (Newman), or the Collection Runner with automated=true. Requests run in order and pass ids along; "Manual" requests are skipped.

Generated by postman/build-collection.mjs — edit that file, not this collection, or changes will be overwritten on the next push.

request.description: Saves idToken (sent as the Bearer token), accessToken, refreshToken and expiresIn.
Every field is optional; only the fields sent are changed.
Default first. Each address has an id for editing.

exec: pm.test('one default, with ids', () => { pm.expect(r.items.filter((a) => a.isDefault)).to.have.lengthOf(1); r.items.forEach((a) => pm.expect(a.id).to.be.a('string')); });

request.description: Partial: only the fields sent change.

exec: pm.test('edited, rest kept', () => { pm.expect(a.line2).to.eql('Suite 200'); pm.expect(a.line1).to.eql('500 Main St'); });

pm.test('first is default, work is not', () => { pm.expect(r.items[0].id).to.eql(pm.environment.get('homeAddressId')); pm.expect(r.items.find((a) => a.id === pm.environment.get('addressId')).isDefault).to.be.false; });

request.description: A Staff or Admins user. Saves adminIdToken, used by Catalog → Admin.

item.name: Manual (email codes)

request.description: Use the code emailed by Cognito.
Admins only. role: CUSTOMER | STAFF | ADMIN. Takes effect on the target user's next sign-in or refresh.

item.description: Skipped in automated runs: these send emails, need a code from an inbox, or change real roles.

exec: pm.test('active, with summary', () => { pm.expect(p.state).to.eql('ACTIVE'); pm.expect(p.summary).to.eql('10% off'); });

request.description: The cart's quick check. The checkout quote decides the actual discount.

exec: pm.test('valid, with summary', () => { pm.expect(r.valid).to.be.true; pm.expect(r.summary).to.eql('10% off'); });
pm.test('not valid', () => { const r = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(r.valid).to.be.false; pm.expect(r.message).to.be.a('string'); });

request.description: Call on every checkout change. Problems come back as issues with HTTP 200.

exec: pm.test('asks for a method and contact', () => pm.expect(q.issues.map((i) => i.code)).to.include.members(['METHOD_REQUIRED', 'CONTACT_REQUIRED']));

request.description: A code that doesn't apply comes back with the reason; it doesn't block payment.

exec: pm.test('total = subtotal + fees + tax', () => { const t = q.totals; pm.expect(t.totalCents).to.eql(t.subtotalCents - t.discountCents + t.deliveryCents + t.shippingCents + t.taxCents); });

request.description: With the 10% code from Promotions (sent empty when that folder was skipped).

exec: pm.test('total = subtotal + fees + tax', () => { const t = q.totals; pm.expect(t.totalCents).to.eql(t.subtotalCents - t.discountCents + t.deliveryCents + t.shippingCents + t.taxCents); });
pm.test('discount spread over items', () => pm.expect(q.groups.flatMap((g) => g.items).reduce((s, i) => s + i.discountCents, 0)).to.eql(q.totals.discountCents));

exec: pm.test('one redemption, for this order', () => { pm.expect(r.total).to.eql(1); pm.expect(r.items[0].orderNumber).to.eql(pm.environment.get('orderNumber')); });

request.description: The paid cart is closed, so the guest cart is no longer found.
Removes lines left by earlier runs (their test products are archived by Teardown).

exec: for (const l of pm.response.json().lines) pm.sendRequest({ url: pm.variables.replaceIn('{{base_url}}/carts/me/cart/items/') + l.variantId, method: 'DELETE', header: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + pm.environment.get('idToken') } }, () => {});

request.description: Contact comes from the account (email is always the verified account email). The guest order above used the same email, so the one-per-customer code is refused.

exec: pm.test('total = subtotal + fees + tax', () => { const t = q.totals; pm.expect(t.totalCents).to.eql(t.subtotalCents - t.discountCents + t.deliveryCents + t.shippingCents + t.taxCents); });

if (pm.environment.get('promoCode') && pm.environment.get('orderNumber')) pm.test('one-per-customer code refused', () => { pm.expect(q.promotion.applied).to.be.false; pm.expect(q.promotion.message).to.include('already used'); });

request.description: Reads the current version, then archives both test codes.

exec: const archive = (id, version) => pm.sendRequest({ url: pm.variables.replaceIn('{{base_url}}/promotions/admin/') + id, method: 'PUT', header: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: 'Bearer ' + pm.environment.get('adminIdToken') }, body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ version, status: 'ARCHIVED' }) } }, (err, res) => pm.test('archived ' + id, () => pm.expect(res.json().state).to.eql('ARCHIVED')));

item.description: Archives the product, category and promo codes created by the run so they leave the storefront.
